confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of local price levels; no live listings, booking pages, or menus were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is less certain and reflects July low-season (rainy season) rates including typical taxes and service charges. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor (about 3.3x and 4x), because direct price knowledge for them is weaker. FX observation came from RBA statistics-page snippets returned by search; the table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital and backpacker-hub price tiers, with US-dollar pricing common in Cambodia. No single named comparable city was used.
